title.en: Fable 28 — The Ant and the Grasshopper

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.en: In the hot summer the ants worked in the field.

sentences.ar: הן לקחו חיטה והכניסו אותם לחור.
sentences.en: They took wheat and brought them into the hole.
They worked from morning until evening.
A grasshopper sat on grass and played music.
He called to the ant: come to me.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: תשבי, ואת תשמעי, ואת תנוחי.
sentences.en: He said: sit, and listen, and rest.

sentences.ar: הנמלה אמרה: אין לי זמן עכשיו.
sentences.en: The ant said: I have no time now.
She said: the winter will come soon.

sentences.ar: החגב צחק ואמר: יש עוד הרבה זמן.
sentences.en: The grasshopper laughed and said: there is still a lot of time.
The summer ended, and then came the autumn.
The leaves fell, and the days became cold.

sentences.ar: אחר כך התחיל החורף עם הגשם.
sentences.en: Afterwards the winter began with the rain.
In the field no food remained at all.
The grasshopper walked in the wind and looked for something.

sentences.ar: הוא הגיע אל החור של הנמלים.
sentences.en: He reached the hole of the ants.
He said: I am very hungry.
The ant asked: and what did you do in the summer?

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: ניגנתי ושרתי כל היום.
sentences.en: He said: I played and sang all day.

sentences.ar: היא אמרה: אז עכשיו לך לרקוד.
sentences.en: She said: then now go and dance.
